issue.body: ## Summary - declare provider-native versus unsupported thread rollback capabilities - reject unsupported checkpoint reverts before filesystem, index, checkpoint, provider, or projection mutation - make Claude, Cursor, and Grok rollback failures explicit and non-mutating ## Verification - `vp check` - `vp run typecheck` - `vp run test` - focused provider capability and adapter suites: 218 tests passed The repository-wide check reports only existing React nested-component warnings. > [!NOTE] > ### Add preflight capability check for thread rollback in conversation checkpointing > - Introduces `ProviderThreadRollbackMode` ('provider-native' | 'unsupported') to `ProviderAdapterCapabilities` in [ProviderAdapter.ts](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/4048/files#diff-9cf933ad19a5aad62b542cd1e1b35bef3a4df4a1057157d23a0dd62a494fceec). > - Claude, Cursor, and Grok adapters now report `threadRollback: 'unsupported'` and fail `rollbackThread` with a `ProviderAdapterValidationError` instead of mutating in-memory thread state; Codex and OpenCode report `threadRollback: 'provider-native'`. > - `CheckpointReactor` now calls `getCapabilities` before processing `thread.checkpoint.revert`; if the provider reports rollback as unsupported, it emits a `checkpoint.revert.failed` activity and aborts without touching the checkpoint store, workspace, or VCS. > - `resolveSessionRuntimeForThread` now requires `providerInstanceId` to be present in the active session; threads missing it are treated as having no resolvable runtime. > - Behavioral Change: rollback attempts against Claude, Cursor, and Grok providers now fail fast with a structured error rather than silently mutating state. > > > > Macroscope summarized 727f6c9. > >

#### Approvability

**Verdict:** Needs human review

This PR changes runtime behavior by adding preflight capability checks for thread rollback in CheckpointReactor and modifying three provider adapters (Claude, Cursor, Grok) to fail rollback operations early rather than attempting them. These orchestration-layer changes that gate significant work warrant human review.
